rationale: ACHC gapped up ~15% on an earnings beat but is now trading well below VWAP ($36.63) and the session high ($39.38), sitting at only 23.8% of today's range with the last five 1-minute candles showing a steady drift lower — classic post-gap fade behavior. However, the broad market is under significant stress (SPY -2.61%, VIXY +17.18%), which creates conflicting forces: the stock could continue fading toward the gap fill, but the earnings catalyst provides genuine support. With price already 8.77% off the high and momentum ambiguous (last candle showed a slight bounce), the risk/reward for either direction lacks a clean mechanical setup, and the wide spread (47 bps) adds friction. Skipping until a clearer directional structure emerges.
